column1: # N4 vocabulary: the controlled lemmas of the curriculum grid. Senses are in lexicon/curriculum.tsv; ko = sense 1. Columns: lemma id; orth = written form for the Japanese side; field; ko and kcls = sense 1 and its Korean class; cls, anim; verb features vol, asp, te, neg (suppletive negative); ni=- (time noun without に); num (counter numeral); args = case frame with filler classes; frame = Korean case remapping; grid = sense 1 safe with any filler; ctype = UniDic conjugation type; senses = sense count.
